notes:
v0.1.19 — latency quick wins (MTTCG + low-latency SSH):
- MTTCG: under TCG (no hardware accel) the 8 vCPUs now run in parallel threads (thread=multi) + bigger translation cache (tb-size=256) instead of single-threaded — noticeably snappier typing if you're on TCG.
- Terminal SSH now uses no compression, low-delay QoS and a fast AES-NI cipher first — cheaper per-keystroke echo.
- Groundwork only; the deep transport rebuild (virtio-serial, bypassing SSH+SLIRP) is still coming.
